# (Canon) Darth Maul (IdrisianGraecus) vs Darth Vader (BreakofDawn)

- Directory section: Miscellaneous
- Directory line: Forum Debate, January 16-February 13, 2020 | Draw (Debater Agreement)
- Thread: https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t2169-ss-darth-maul-ig-vs-darth-vader-breakofdawn
- Raw full-thread text (all pages): raw/threads/073.txt
- Notes compiled: 2026-10-20

## Matchup & conditions
- **(Canon) Darth Maul** (Rebels S3E20 "Twin Suns"), argued by IdrisianGraecus ("IG"), vs **Darth Vader** (Jedi: Fallen Order), argued by BreakofDawn ("BoD").

## Result (FORUM OPINION)
- **Directory: "Draw (Debater Agreement)"** (Jan 16 – Feb 13, 2020).
- Posts made: IG's P8 opener, BoD's P16 opener, and IG's P21 post 2. BoD never posted his second.
- IG (P31): "Per BoD and my mutual agreement, this debate has been declared a draw."
- An off-topic post from CSWDB was removed. Praxis (P26) explained the "Suspect Showdown" two-debater rule.

## Maul (IG)
### P8
- **I. Ahsoka:**
  - Rebels Ahsoka "charges Vader, lands a kick, dodges his strikes, engages in bladelock with him, breaks it, dodges again, then TK blasts him".
  - "While Vader is superior both holistically and demonstrably, Ahsoka clearly comp[etes]".
- **II. Maul's superiority:**
  - Maul is paired with Ezra as the "logical choice" ("the weakest of the Jedi"), which makes Maul the strongest of the group.
  - Maul kills Inquisitors and "does so easily". Inquisitor clip: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=04V0nS8AP2g
  - Maul has a mobility and stylistic edge over Vader.
- **III. Vader's growth:**
  - Vader's prime is Rebels–ANH, so JFO Vader is weaker.
  - Quoted: *Lords of the Sith* meditation, and Insider 157 ("Somewhere in the back of Palpatine's mind, he knows what Vader's potential is").
- **Conclusion bullets:**
  - "Ahsoka is capable of contending with Vader in a direct way, establishing relativity, if not parity."
  - "Maul is far more powerful than Ahsoka at this time"
  - "Vader in Fallen Order is far weaker than Vader in Rebels"
  - "Maul has a stylistic advantage in his mobility".

### P21
- Ahsoka's honed skills (Insider 159).
- Holding-back Maul is still superior to Ahsoka.
- Siege of Mandalore Ahsoka ~ Maul there, while Rebels Maul > improved Ahsoka.
- *Lords of the Sith*: "with only a fraction of his power, Sidious performs at least equal (if not superiorly) to Vader", but by Rebels Vader is noted as superior to Sidious. So Vader grew massively from JFO to Rebels.
- "Rebels is Maul’s prime in canon, and he’s shown an ability (via scaling) to at least be comparable to Prime Vader, if not equal."

## Vader (BoD, P16)
### Inquisitors are low-tier
- A Rebels creator quote: "I would say someone like Mace Windu is far far far above the Inquisitor we've seen in Star Wars Rebels."
- Ahsoka tooled them in S2E9. Filoni: "She’s never really in jeopardy, Ashoka, in that fight." (Rebels Recon #2.09)
- Maul was an unknown to them: "So, the rumours are true. Darth Maul lives." (Seventh Sister)
- The "easily" kills came from surprise and from Ahsoka disarming the Fifth Brother.
- Ahsoka ragdolled the Seventh Sister into a pillar. "While Maul is superior, he is not superior by any noticeable or considerable margin."

### Vader's Force feats in JFO, against Maul's best canon TK (pulling a shuttle off a cliff while enraged)
- Overpowering two Inquisitors' combined TK and throwing a speeder back at them.
- Containing grenade blasts while snapping two clones' necks.
- "Completely freezing two enraged Inquisitors with the Force".
- Ragdolling Cere and Cal, and stopping debris while choking Cal.
- Bending doors and throwing generators.
- **"holding back the oceans of Nur, a water moon".**

### Sabers
- Vader matched Eeth Koth, who matched Grievous, and Grievous matched prime Maul in Son of Dathomir.

## Neutral assessment
- The crux is Ahsoka as a proxy: does Rebels Maul > Rebels Ahsoka, and does that scale to the earlier, weaker JFO Vader?
- BoD's JFO Force feats (Nur's ocean) are strong evidence against Maul.
- Unfinished; draw by agreement.

Given that there are around 12 years or so between Fallen Order and S2 of Rebels, we can assume that Vader grows immensely, and his skills as a combatant are far greater as well.

**Q3** — Source: Lords of the Sith
> VADER COMPLETED HIS MEDITATION and opened his eyes. His pale, flame-savaged face stared back at him from out of the reflective black surface of his pressurized meditation chamber. Without the neural connection to his armor, he was conscious of the stumps of his legs, the ruin of his arm, the perpetual pain in his flesh. He welcomed it. Pain fed his hate, and hate fed his strength. Once, as a Jedi, he had meditated to find peace. Now he meditated to sharpen the edges of his anger.
> He stared at his reflection a long time. His injuries had deformed his body, left it a ruin, but they’d perfected his spirit, strengthening his connection to the Force. Suffering had birthed insight.

**Q14** — Source: Lords of the Sith
> Vader looked from his Master to the dark mouth of the mine inside of which Drua and the rest of the villagers had fled. He felt the Emperor's eyes on him, the intensity of the gaze, the weight of his expectations, and Vader knew that the day's events had been only half about depleting a rebel movement before it could grow. They had also, as Vader had suspected, been about testing him, forcing him to face the ghosts of his past and exorcise them forever and fully. He saw that more clearly now; saw, too, that his Master was right to administer the test. It also explained why his Master had shown so little of his true power throughout the day. Perhaps he'd wanted Vader to rely on himself to overcome the challenges they'd faced. Or perhaps he'd wanted to seem weaker than he was, to draw out any treacherous ambitions Vader may have held.
